question: The paper describes 12 RNA-seq samples (2 hybrids x 2 N x 3), but SRP341978 has 24 runs: aliases XYC1-3/XYT1-3/HNC1-3/HNT1-3 and XYCa-c/XYTa-c/HNCa-c/HNTa-c. What distinguishes the two sets, and which set is the paper's grain-filling (R3) data?
proposed_answer: Unresolved; do not pool the sets as 6 replicates. Most likely two stages: the same group's companion paper (Wang et al. 2022 Genes 13:670, PMC9030517) sampled uppermost fully expanded leaves of the same hybrids under N0/N240 at V12, and both papers cite the same PRIDE dataset PXD028027 (3 TMT10 plexes = 30 channels, room for 24 samples). Ask the authors (Duan H., Hebei Agricultural University), or infer later from data (clustering by set; senescence/grain-filling markers). Until then stage = NR and other_factor = SRA sample set.
evidence: runs.tsv aliases; BioSample collection_date 2018-08-12 for all 24; PMC10603844 Methods 2.2 (12 samples); PMC9030517 Methods 2.3 (V12, uppermost fully expanded leaf, 12 proteomic samples); PRIDE PXD028027 file list (bjhb1-3 x 10 raw files).

question: RNA-seq Methods say 'uppermost fully expanded leaves'; Methods 2.1 says leaf tissue (~10 cm from the middle of the ear leaf) at R3 for proteomics. Which leaf was sequenced?
proposed_answer: Leaf either way (tissue_group unaffected); tissue_detail records both statements. Resolve together with the set question.
